verdict.rationale: Stripe documents built-in automatic fraud/risk controls for Treasury and Issuing, and explicitly places responsibility on the platform to 'build and operate controls' for onboarding, transfers, returns, negative balances, and feature changes — implying ops teams must construct their own velocity/hold/freeze logic rather than getting a turnkey per-account/per-program control panel. There is no documented UI or API for setting transaction/velocity limits, initiating holds, or a defined account-freeze-to-reinstatement workflow. Missing for 10: explicit velocity/transaction limit configuration, documented hold-on-suspicious-activity mechanism, and a defined freeze/reinstatement process with audit trail.
